title: Ansel and the Hollow
author: C. M. Quintana
blurb: Edmund Marchetti, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent three years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
